name: minigrep
title: An I/O Project: Building a Command Line Program
description: A small version of the grep tool. You give it a word and a file, and it prints every line of the file that contains the word.
prerequisite: Uses modules, collections, error handling, traits and tests from chapters 7 to 11.

steps.title: Refactoring to Improve Modularity and Error Handling
steps.teaches: Split into lib.rs and return Result

steps.title: Adding Functionality with Test Driven Development
steps.teaches: Write a failing test, then search

files.poem.txt:
I'm nobody! Who are you?
Are you nobody, too?
Then there's a pair of us - don't tell!
They'd banish us, you know.

How dreary to be somebody!
How public, like a frog
To tell your name the livelong day
To an admiring bog!

name: hello
title: Final Project: Building a Multithreaded Web Server
description: A small web server. It answers browser requests with an HTML page and uses a pool of threads so it can handle several requests at once.
prerequisite: Uses closures, smart pointers, threads, channels and trait objects from chapters 13 to 18.

steps.title: Graceful Shutdown and Cleanup
steps.teaches: Implement Drop and join the workers
